newsitem.title: USA: Primus sees '97 EPS in line with forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Primus sees '97 EPS in line with forecasts.

text.p: Primus Telecommunications Group Inc on Tuesday it expected its earnings throughout 1997 to be in line with analysts' expectations.
The company also said an unspecified fraud, allegedly perpetrated by a single business customer, was expected to hurt its gross margins and net revenues in the first quarter.
The company in a statement did not provide details about the alleged fraud, but said it was detected and stopped.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Primus said it also expected further delays in persuading customers to migrate to its network of switches and leased lines.
